findings.description: ID generation uses crypto.randomUUID() instead of branded format (F###, P###, S###) across all 3 entity routers
findings.impact: Stored IDs violate type system branding conventions. Won't match expected patterns for FeatureId/ProjectId/SessionId.
findings.suggested_fix: Implement sequential ID generation in repositories using max(id) + 1 pattern

findings.description: bulkUpdateStatus has TOCTOU race: validates transitions, then updates in separate operations without transaction
findings.impact: Concurrent bulk updates could bypass state machine rules
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap validation + update in a Drizzle transaction

findings.description: bulkUpdateStatus silently skips non-existent feature IDs instead of returning error
findings.impact: Client receives success response but some IDs were not processed
findings.suggested_fix: Collect missing IDs and throw ORPCError NOT_FOUND

findings.description: Settings default mismatch between DB schema (stores {}) and Zod transform (expects undefined to apply defaults)
findings.impact: Partially provided settings may miss default values for locale, notifications, etc.
findings.suggested_fix: Align transform to handle {} case or use deep merge for defaults

findings.description: Projects table missing 'status' column defined in ProjectSchema Zod type
findings.impact: Runtime errors when reading/writing project.status from DB
findings.suggested_fix: Add status text column with default 'draft' + migration

findings.description: F007 AC4 requires flexible settings column — status field gap between Zod schema and DB
findings.impact: Feature not fully meeting acceptance criteria
findings.suggested_fix: Add status column to projects table

findings.description: F011 AC3 'Schema version tracked' — no version tracking exposed to application
findings.suggested_fix: Query Drizzle metadata table for current version

findings.description: F011 AC4 'Rollback capability exists' — no rollback mechanism implemented
findings.suggested_fix: Document rollback strategy or implement manual rollback scripts

findings.description: VALID_TRANSITIONS state machine duplicated in 4 files
findings.impact: State machine changes require updating 4 files in sync

findings.description: statusColors mapping duplicated in 3 frontend files
findings.impact: UI color inconsistency risk on changes

findings.description: EstimatedSize enum duplicated instead of importing from @nomos-ai/types
findings.impact: Size options diverge if updated in one location only
findings.suggested_fix: Import EstimatedSizeSchema from @nomos-ai/types in router and form

findings.description: Identical error handling try-catch pattern duplicated 8+ times across routers
findings.impact: Error handling changes require updating all routers

findings.suggested_fix: Infer type from oRPC client or create shared type

findings.description: DB file location defaults to local.db instead of .nomos/data/ as documented
findings.impact: Database may not persist in expected location
findings.suggested_fix: Update DATABASE_URL docs/example to point to .nomos/data/

findings.description: Missing preImplemented boolean field in features DB table
findings.impact: Cannot persist pre-implemented flag for features

findings.description: Missing 'check' or 'lint' pipeline in turbo.json (F001 AC1)
Health check response time not measured against 100ms AC
No integration tests for invalid state transitions
